intent: Improve customer usability through computed agency setup and next actions, scoped client review queues/current files, dirty-dialog protection, clear filters and contextual manual invitations. Preserve authorization, immutable decisions and session/revision safety.

findings.suggested_fix: When work exists but no decision has been received, derive the setup invitation target from an active project that has a latest pending deliverable, rather than the first active project. If no eligible pending work exists, offer an appropriate project/work action instead of an unrelated invitation. Add a regression with an earlier empty project for client A and pending work in a later project for client B, asserting the setup invitation preselects B.
findings.title: First-review invitation targets a client without pending work
findings.why_it_matters: If an agency creates an empty project for client A before submitting its first work for client B, the first-review guide shows 3 of 4 steps complete but its invitation button selects client A. Following that prominent setup action sends the agency toward inviting a client with nothing to review, rather than collecting the outstanding first decision. The progress calculation searches all linked projects, while the invitation target independently uses the first active project; deriving the target from the actual pending review work keeps the action consistent with the completed step.
evidence: Read-only Node VM reproduction against the reviewed source: projects=[empty-project/client empty-client, ready-project/client ready-client], with one pending deliverable in ready-project and no approvals, renders 3 of 4 complete and the setup button data-pf-invite-client=empty-client.

requirements.requirement: Client latest-version queue, jump, filters and current snapshots
Dirty dialog keep/discard and page-exit warning, no persisted drafts
Archive-aware active agency review statistics and inbox
Contextual invitation prefill, copy and same-computer limitation
Task/request filter reset and empty Files guidance
Successful snapshot freshness with explicit manual refresh

residual_risks: This scope review does not establish production readiness or usability with real customers. Council lenses and local reviewers share the model family.
Manual refresh remains explicit; this change does not implement live subscriptions, persistent draft recovery or account recovery.
